senses.gloss: m. (preced.) something small; ק׳ דארעא (or sub. דארעא) a small piece of ground.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 59a:18">B. Kam. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>אגב ק׳ דא׳</he> in connection with a small piece of ground.
<cite ref="Ketubot 91b:15">Keth. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>שבק ק׳ דא׳ וכ׳</he> left to his heirs a small piece of ground worth fifty Zuz.
<cite ref="Ketubot 91b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>הני חמשין זוזי דמי דארעא ק׳</he> (Rashi: <he>דמי ק׳</he>) these fifty Zuz I give in payment for the small field.

<cite ref="Gittin 30b:6">Gitt. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כמעשה ק׳ דאביי</he> like the case of the small field that Abayi had to decide upon (Keth. l. c.).—Pl. <cite ref="S00754"><he>קַטִּינֵי</he></cite>. Keth. l. c. <he>תרי ק׳ דא׳</he> two small fields.
